questions.question: Why did Dr. Shady want Nero to help her?
options: To make talking dogs help her take over the world
questions.explanation: 莎迪博士想制造更多会说话的狗并利用它们控制世界。

questions.question: What did Nero want instead of helping the evil plan?
options: A kind friend who would feed him
questions.explanation: 尼禄想要善良的朋友和好吃的零食。

questions.question: Why did Nero tear up Dr. Shady's slippers?
options: He wanted to test their strength
He was asked to clean them
He wanted her to throw him outside so he could escape
questions.explanation: 尼禄故意弄坏拖鞋，借博士发怒被扔出去寻找逃跑机会。

questions.question: How did Nero escape through the fence?
options: He dug under it and squeezed through
questions.explanation: 尼禄挖洞，从篱笆下钻出去逃走。

questions.question: Whom did Nero meet after escaping into town?
questions.explanation: 尼禄逃到镇上后遇到了少年德夫。

questions.question: Where did Dev ask Nero to hide when Dad arrived?
options: Under a pile of stuffed toys
questions.explanation: 爸爸进来时德夫让尼禄藏到毛绒玩具下面。

questions.question: What made Dad suspect there was a real talking dog?
options: A squirrel ran into the room
Nero complained that a stuffed carrot was fuzzy
Dr. Shady called on the phone
questions.explanation: 尼禄把毛绒胡萝卜当食物咬，还说它毛茸茸，引起爸爸怀疑。

questions.question: Under what condition did Dad agree Dev could keep Nero?
options: If they could not find his owner
questions.explanation: 爸爸说如果找不到主人，就可以考虑收养尼禄。

questions.question: What did Nero chase in the park?
questions.explanation: 尼禄见到松鼠后挣脱背带追了过去。

questions.question: Who appeared from a bush at the end?
questions.explanation: 莎迪博士从灌木丛中跳了出来。

questions.question: Where did Dev suggest hiding from Dr. Shady first?
questions.explanation: 德夫建议先躲到旋转木马上避开博士。

questions.question: Why couldn't Nero help pedal the paddleboat?
options: His paws could not reach the pedals
questions.explanation: 尼禄的爪子够不到脚踏板。

questions.question: What caused Nero and Dev to fall into the lake?
options: Their boat tipped while Nero leaned into the water
The boat ran out of fuel
questions.explanation: 尼禄伸爪玩水导致船倾斜，两人落入湖里。

questions.question: Who did Dr. Shady collide with on the water?
questions.explanation: 莎迪博士驾船追赶时撞到了市长的脚踏船。

questions.question: What happened when Dev and Nero thought they had escaped?
options: Nero ran into a pet shop
questions.explanation: 两人以为甩掉了博士，但博士突然抓住尼禄。

questions.question: How did the mayor decide Nero's owner?
options: By asking Nero to choose between Dev and Dr. Shady
questions.explanation: 市长把双方分开，让尼禄自己选主人。

questions.question: What first tempted Nero to run toward Dr. Shady?
questions.explanation: 莎迪博士摇晃尼禄爱吃的Doggie Doodles零食袋。

questions.question: What reminded Nero to choose Dev instead?
options: A leash lying on the ground
questions.explanation: 尼禄想到德夫温暖的家和摸耳朵的关爱，决定选择友谊。

questions.question: What did Nero do after making his final choice?
options: Run back and jump on Dev
questions.explanation: 尼禄转身奔向德夫，还扑到他身上。

questions.question: What did Dad finally accept?
options: That Nero could become their new pet
That Dr. Shady should take Nero
That the mayor owned every dog
That Dev had to return the dog immediately
questions.explanation: 爸爸最后接受尼禄成为家里的新宠物。

questions.question: What game were Nero and Dev playing at home?
questions.explanation: 雨天两人在家玩你演我猜。

questions.question: What evidence showed that Nero had made a mess in the kitchen?
questions.explanation: 厨房地板上是泥和爪印，爸爸发现尼禄闯了祸。

questions.question: Why did Dad want Nero to attend Pam's K9 Academy?
options: He wanted Dev to learn science
Nero needed training because of his behavior
questions.explanation: 尼禄咬拖鞋、弄脏厨房，还翻垃圾，爸爸认为他必须接受训练。

questions.question: What distracted Nero when Dev told him to sit?
options: A bird flying past the window
A new toy on the floor
questions.explanation: 尼禄刚坐下就看见窗外飞过的鸟，马上冲过去。

questions.question: Why did Nero feel jealous at the academy?
options: Dev was admiring and petting another talented dog
Pam refused to give him food
The dogs were taking a test
He had to stay in a cage
questions.explanation: 德夫夸奖另一只会玩飞盘和滑板的狗，还摸了它，尼禄很嫉妒。
